notes: Bundled ESP32-S3 Switch 2 Pro bridge firmware V5.0.0. BLE FD2 input is about the 133 Hz class on tested hardware; gyro uses raw-like FD2 motion passthrough into USB report 0x05; USB defaults to 250 Hz for gyro stability and keeps 1000 Hz as an optional experimental mode. Rumble bridge is implemented, but HD Rumble 2 audio/voice is not implemented.
